Package de.labathome.trustconstr.interfaces

Interface VectorFunctionLike

All Known Implementing Classes:
IdentityVectorFunction, LinearVectorFunction, NonlinearVectorFunction, VectorFunction
public interface VectorFunctionLike
Common surface implemented by every vector-valued function carrier the trust-constr code passes around: the full VectorFunction (objective wrapper with caching and finite-difference fallbacks), LinearVectorFunction (constant Jacobian A), and IdentityVectorFunction (Jacobian I).

Mirrors the duck-typed contract scipy relies on -- in _constraints.py:PreparedConstraint the fun attribute can be any of the three Python classes, and downstream code only calls fun(x) / jac(x) / hess(x, v) or reads the cached f / J / m / n.
